EmailTemplate.name: Physics Dept Reserved Seats
EmailTemplate.subject: Information regarding course override in Department of Physics
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Unfortunately, we are unable to provide overrides for reserved seats.
Please hover over the green triangle to the right of the course to see the course reserves, the seats available for each reserve and the reserve release date ("Reserved Until:"). On the release date, you should be able to enroll in any open seat so long as requisites have been met.
I apologize for the inconvenience.
Sincerely,
Department of Physics Arizona State University
